ModMetaData.name: Empire Outposts War (帝國哨站戰爭)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Three-way glue between Empire (Refactored), Rim War and the NPC Outposts cluster. Pure interaction layer — requires Empire Warfare and NPC Outposts: Rim War.

Features:
- Player vassal settlements grow their own satellite outposts, which boost the vassal's tax output and abstract defense strength.
- Outposts act as a defensive buffer: nearby same-owner outposts add to a vassal's defense, and the outposts around a hostile NPC settlement add to its defense when you launch an Empire Capture against it (strip them first to soften the target).
- Conquest spoils: when you capture an NPC settlement its satellite outposts defect to your empire; when a vassal falls its outposts are handed to the conqueror.

All cross-mod hooks are fail-soft: if any dependency changes its signatures the affected sub-feature degrades quietly instead of crashing. Safe to add to existing saves.
